contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #243: Separating choiceless counting from polynomial time and witnessed choice.
Source-faithful scope audit of OpenAI manuscript family 243 and its unrestricted-rank counting model, with the primary GSWv1 interpretation characterization and pinned upstream evidence.

definitions.HF: Atoms and hereditarily finite sets of every finite rank; no constant rank cutoff.
definitions.IL: Fixed parameter-free two-dimensional FO+H interpretation program with generated-equivalence quotients, existentially saturated relations, and total polynomial h+sum(state sizes) cost.
definitions.EvaluationDefinable: FullCPT guarded acceptance with polynomial step bound and polynomial cumulative hereditary occurring-family bound, including evaluated temporary roots.
definitions.source_evidence: Reading a declaration or proof source is not an independent compiler certificate or a novelty claim.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 243 (Separating choiceless counting from polynomial time and witnessed choice.; papers: Choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time; Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/243.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

P1 00-introduction.tex thm:main: the specified query Q on all finite structures in the fixed eight-binary-relation vocabulary is isomorphism-invariant, decidable in deterministic polynomial time, and not definable in full choiceless polynomial time with counting. Source map and unverified dependencies: research/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md.

P1 00-introduction.tex prop:query-ptime: Q is invariant and polynomial-time decidable on every finite input; its consistency system has at most 2n separate unknowns and n+n^2 equations. This is a manuscript assertion mapped to source, not a local universal certificate.

P1 02-structures.tex lem:universe-size and prop:opposite-answers: for every L>=2, the zero-charge and unit-charge grid inputs have equal size N=Theta(L^3) and satisfy Q and not Q respectively, including arbitrary field-valued configuration weights.

P1 03-support.tex lem:H-automorphisms and equations H-product/H-commutator: the alternating-cocycle central extension H acts by automorphisms on every A_b; its central flow subgroup adds edge scalars and its commutator is the signed sum of face cycles.
P1 03-support.tex lem:sparse-cochain: every F3 edge cochain with nonzero curl on exactly t faces of the L-box differs from a gradient by a cochain supported on at most 2Lt edges, including t=0.

P1 03-support.tex prop:small-orbit-support and cor:transitive-support, and P2 05-support.tex sup:small-orbit/sup:hereditary: an H-orbit of size at most N^q gives a K-support of at most 2L(q log_3 N)^2 atoms, independent of HF rank; invariant transitive polynomial families give hereditary supports.

P1 04-base-logic.tex prop:base-equivalence and P2 06-base-counting.tex base:equivalence: for sufficiently large L the same-size zero/unit-charge analytical expansions agree on all C^M sentences, M=floor(L^(7/4)).

P1 04-base-logic.tex prop:base-homogeneity and P2 06-base-counting.tex base:homogeneity: if 7r+7(6r/c)^(3/2)+1<=M, then same-C^M-type r-tuples in one expansion are in the same central-flow K-orbit; empty tuples require no width hypothesis.

P1 05-hf-transfer.tex thm:hf-transfer and P2 07-hf-transfer.tex hf:transfer: for nonempty finite bases, base C^M equivalence and K-orbit homogeneity through max(2,m)s positions imply C^m equivalence of the all-finite-rank hereditarily s-supported domains when max(4,m+1)s<=M.

P1 06-coding.tex interpretation characterization: every property of finite binary relational structures definable in full counting CPT is decided by a fixed total polynomial-cost FO+H interpretation program with generated quotient semantics. This is the direction of GSWv1 Section 6 Theorem 18 used in this audit.

P1 06-coding.tex lem:trace-size: when N, all state sizes and the halt stage are at most B>=2, input atoms, tagged whole-class vertex codes and all recursive constituents lie in an H-invariant membership-transitive family of at most 9B^3 objects, without a rank restriction.

P1 06-coding.tex lem:state-exactness: over the transitive supported domains, the common stage formulas define exactly the actual tagged quotient vertices, binary relations, halt and output through the respective halt stages, also for empty states.

P1 06-coding.tex lem:substitution-width and its final application: capture-avoiding substitution preserves the maximum subformula-free-variable measure, measure w permits w+1 names, and every expanded state/halt/output comparison formula has a program-dependent constant variable bound independent of stages and input size.
P1 07-separation.tex proof: every fixed full counting CPT program agrees on the zero/unit-charge grid pair for all sufficiently large L, contradicting their opposite query answers if it decides Q.

At openai/math commit 4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae, Grid.lean:117-210 contains subgroup_support_edges and small_orbit_support_edges for arbitrary BoxGroup actions, with no HF-rank hypothesis. Treating their mathematical conclusions as available is an external, not locally compiled, premise in this scope.

At openai/math commit 4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae, Separation.lean:7-24 states query invariance, OrdinaryPolynomialTime, and non-FullCPT.EvaluationDefinable. Its proof closure has not been independently compiled in this mission and is an external premise, not earned local kernel evidence.

P1 06-coding.tex:15-62, GSW arXiv:2003.10935v1 Section 6, and pinned Interpretations.lean:16-108 agree on FO+H with free outer variables, pair-domain generated quotients, existential representative saturation, first halt after initialization, and sum-of-state-sizes polynomial cost, up to the exact index shift h=j+1.

Every fixed total polynomial-cost binary interpretation program deciding Q has a FullCPT.Program deciding Q with polynomial step bound and polynomial cumulative occurring-object bound, including temporary roots and their hereditary constituents, without a fixed HF-rank bound. A constructive one-way simulation proof, not a kernel-checked compiler, is in research/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md.

Conditional on GSWv1 Theorem 18 and correctness of the pinned upstream separation proof, the manuscript full counting CPT class embeds in FullCPT.EvaluationDefinable via the explicit polynomial complete-evaluation simulation, so the upstream lower bound covers the unrestricted-rank counting claim. No converse, new separation theorem, or local Lean certification is asserted.

For an atom a, the singleton chain x_0=a and x_(t+1)={x_t} has rank t and exactly t+1 distinct hereditary objects through stage t. Thus polynomial cumulative HF-object count does not imply a rank bound constant in input size; this refutes a local reduction shortcut, not a manuscript assertion.

The rerunnable certificate verifies 531 identification relations on domain sizes 0..3, 5205 empty/singleton saturation checks, 3107 relabelings, 85 bounded Hartig comparisons, signed one-face F3 Heisenberg identities, one exact Jacobian 27-point orbit, and an exact positive-coefficient proof of the 9B^3 trace inequality for every B>=2. These finite checks do not certify a universal separation or the prose compiler.

P2 00-introduction.tex:38-51 thm:main: one fixed sentence with exactly one witnessed symmetric choice occurrence and a fixed polynomial annotation is Boolean on every finite eight-relation input, and its true-model class is not definable in full counting CPT.

P2 01-formalism.tex:70-115: every first-stabilization choice path must be witnessed; at each stage witnesses are full-input automorphisms fixing the parameters and all earlier states, act transitively on the candidates, and meet polynomial path, state and temporary-object bounds. This records the definition, not an inferred construction theorem.

P2 03-sentence.tex:532-711 sen:all-input and sen:polynomial: the guarded one-WSC sentence gives a Boolean answer on every finite input under one fixed polynomial, using full-input automorphism filtering and monotone-state history preservation.

P2 04-grid-behavior.tex:106-236 grid:transitivity: for every resolving parameter, compatible prefix and ordered pair of candidates, a filtered full-input automorphism fixes the selected history and maps the first candidate to the second; the construction uses local face translations and a tree-return circulation.

P2 04-grid-behavior.tex:283-318 grid:separation: every terminal path accepts the zero-charge grid and rejects the unit-charge grid without dagger, by tree divergence solvability and total-charge cancellation.

P2 08-cpt-lower-bound.tex:56-116 eval:trace: the complete deterministic evaluation trace of a fixed CPT sentence, including rejected candidates and final stationarity candidates, is polynomial-size, invariant and membership-transitive.

P2 08-cpt-lower-bound.tex:128-430 eval:description: every actual CPT activation has an exact fixed-width C^m evaluation description whose value is unique over the entire supported domain, with rejected, empty/default and stationarity cases included.

P2 08-cpt-lower-bound.tex:430-505 eval:pair-equivalence: every fixed CPT sentence agrees on the zero/unit-charge pair for all sufficiently large L, using the shared rank-independent support, base equivalence/homogeneity, HF transfer, and full-trace/evaluation-description obligations.

Campaign completion still requires a genuinely new publishable independent mathematical theorem, repaired theorem or exact manuscript counterexample; existing upstream results, source correspondence and finite checks alone do not satisfy that requirement.
An independent Reviewer must replay and accept the genuinely new publishable result before campaign completion. No such result or Reviewer acceptance has been produced by this scope mission.

routes.retired_because: A singleton chain has rank t and only t+1 hereditary objects. A fixed-rank truncation does not follow from polynomial trace size and cannot certify the unrestricted-rank claim. This is a rejected local approach, not a false manuscript assertion.
